prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Finished transparent terrain tile atlas 水域 for 三国赤壁 HD redraw. Repaint ALL cells in the reference atlas while preserving EXACT canvas proportions, original layout, diamond ground silhouettes, cliff/wall heights, edge cutouts and seamless neighboring variants. Each tile originally 44x22; exact 14 columns x 6 rows. Preserve original color palette, isometric 2:1 orthographic perspective and upper-left light. Fully redraw detailed hand-painted grass/earth/water/stone/wood material appropriate to reference; no change to geography, no scenery or extra objects. Fourfold reference resolution if possible. True transparent alpha wherever reference is transparent. No labels/grid/text/black rectangle/checkerboard/watermark. All variants required, not one isolated tile. Keep all source-empty cells empty and each occupied cell in its EXACT source position. Do not compact, rearrange or evenly fill the atlas. Never move any tile to another row or column.

userAcceptance.reason: 用户已人工验证高清图，要求直接替换对应素材，不再逐项美术复核。
